chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Knowledge is a venerable estate; good manners are new dresses; and thinking is clear mirror.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of knowledge, manners, and reflection in Shia ethics?
ai.summary: In this aphorism from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elevates knowledge to a dignified legacy, while characterizing adab (manners) as renewing garments that reflect inner purity, and thought as a polished mirror for discerning reality. This triad underscores the Shia emphasis on the integration of intellectual acquisition, ethical refinement, and contemplative insight as essential components of spiritual and intellectual maturity.
